The site also exposes a public SharePoint share (EUIT-TECHLIBRARY) that answered 200 anonymously on the same date -- not authored, because an anonymous SharePoint link is not a stable published source and nobody has asked Euronda whether it is meant to be reachable. Credentials or an email.request are the realistic routes here.
